description: An eczema pattern with numerous inflammatory lesions distributed over multiple body areas.
causes: Inflammatory dermatitis; the exact trigger varies by eczema subtype

appearance.general: Multiple dry, inflamed, scaly patches or plaques may be distributed over the trunk and limbs.

warning_signs: Rapidly worsening pain, pus, fever, or extensive blistering warrants medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss possible triggers, distribution, duration, and any history of atopic or contact dermatitis.
Because this label describes a pattern rather than a single subtype, clinical evaluation should determine the underlying eczema subtype.
